# SK0209 — The expression parentheses are not arranged

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

`skala arrange --aggressive` would remove redundant parentheses.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | suggestion |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 2.0 |

## Why

Parenthesis removal is the arranger's highest-risk syntactic cleanup and is therefore gated by `--aggressive`. It uses Roslyn precedence and refuses directive or trivia shapes whose ownership would change.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
return (value);
```

Write:

```csharp
return value;
```

## When it does not fire

The rule is off unless `--aggressive` is selected. Parentheses required for precedence or configured readability remain.

## Configuration

- `resharper_csharp_parentheses_redundancy_style`
- `dotnet_style_parentheses_in_arithmetic_binary_operators`
- `dotnet_style_parentheses_in_relational_binary_operators`
- `dotnet_style_parentheses_in_other_binary_operators`
